bandBio: FOURPLAY Dance Band with songstress Taryn McCallum is a rocking, dancing good time! Playing the greater Bay Area for over 7 years, these talented musicians bring their infectious enthusiasm for today’s dance hits along with humor for an always enjoyable event. The band mixes today’s greatest dance hits by artists such as Lizzo, Dua Lipa and Pink with an assortment of classics by Whitney Houston, Donna Summer and Gloria Gaynor. Taryn is an accomplished vocalist embracing some of the most iconic artists and genres to each performance. She sings a range of hits including country artists Gretchen Wilson and Dolly Parton. Her band mates bring decades of musical experience and fun to every entertainment event. Bring your dancing shoes and a smile to a unique and outstanding musical experience with the FOURPLAY Dance Band.

members.name: Jeff Pavon
members.bio:
With over 50 years of experience as a drummer, vocalist, and songwriter, I bring a deep dedication to music performance and collaboration. My musical journey began in junior high jazz band and continued through competitive high-school programs—an intensive, “Whiplash-level” training that shaped my technical skill and discipline.
Throughout my career, I have performed across a wide range of genres, including classic rock, blues, and hard rock, in both cover bands and original projects. I am proficient in reading drum charts, writing music and lyrics, and providing supporting vocals when needed.
My commitment to the craft, my love for the stage, and the camaraderie of working with fellow musicians—along with the grace of the good Lord above—continue to inspire me to perform, grow, and contribute to every band I’m part of.

members.name: Robby Rottin
members.bio: Robby’s love of music began early while the earth was still cooling. Learning that banging rocks together was not particularly musical, he eventually discovered guitars. Robby has been performing professionally since 2000 in various cover bands. He has played throughout the Bay Area at all types of events and venues. Had his SAT scores been higher, he might have missed this incredible calling of rock and dance music. Come see him in the Fourplay as he finds unique ways to meld low grades, humor and great music for your dancing enjoyment.

members.name: Taryn McCallum
members.bio: Taryn is a lifelong vocalist with over four decades of experience bringing music to life. She has performed at venues large and small across the Bay Area, earning a reputation for her soulful tone, dynamic range, and heartfelt connection with audiences. Whether on stage or in intimate gatherings, her voice leaves a lasting impression.

members.name: Adam Rogers
members.bio: Adam Rogers has been playing piano since age 7. He trained in jazz and blues piano during high school and attended the Berklee College of Music for 1 year after college. He loves music and plays daily, performing as often as he can. Playing in bands is a serious hobby for him and connecting with people through music is his favorite pastime.

members.name: Mark Carlson
members.bio: At ten years old, Mark Carlson bought his first bass guitar from a classified ad. It was a 1973 Fender Jazz he played in school pep, vocal, and jazz bands. His musical journey, dormant for decades, was reignited during the COVID lockdowns, inspiring him to post various bass cover videos online. Today, his bass collection has grown somewhat, but is strictly limited by the number his wife will tolerate.
